Streamline Revenue for Multi-Provider Groups

Affordable & Scalable Medical Billing Services for Group Practices

Managing billing for a group practice requires more than just submitting claims. It requires specialized workflows for multi-provider attribution, audit readiness, and complex payer contracts.

E-nnovationrcm provides specialized RCM services built for multi-provider groups. We help you reduce denials, stay audit-ready for Medicare Advantage (MA) plans, and recover A/R faster.

  • RADV-Ready Workflows: Prepared for risk adjustment audits.
  • Prior-Authorization Automation: Reducing administrative bottlenecks.
  • CPC-Certified Coding Team: Expertise across 75+ specialties.

  • Multi-Provider Groups: We provide comprehensive multi-provider credentialing for both Multi-Specialty & Single-Specialty organizations.
  • Medicare Advantage�Heavy Practices: Specialized RADV compliance.

  • High-Volume Procedural & ASC Groups: Surgical and facility billing.

  • Community Clinics & FQHCs: Value-based care support.

Advanced Workflows for Group Practices

Backed by 10+ years of expertise from our billers and coders, we help practices boost revenue by up to 35% through streamlined, audit-proof workflows.

We automate NPI validation and route claims by TIN. Every charge maps correctly to the right provider and payer, reducing rejections before submission.

NPI, TIN, and Provider Attribution

We tag every MA claim, package RADV-ready audit bundles, and fast-track appeals to protect high-risk revenue.

Mixed Payer & Medicare Advantage (MA) Exposure

Our system runs pre-visit PA checks, captures PA IDs, and links approvals directly to claims. This prevents delays and cuts PA-related denials.

Prior Authorization & ePA Transition

We deliver provider-level dashboards and wRVU-based reports with audit trails so revenue is transparent, disputes are minimized, and providers stay aligned.

Revenue Distribution & Compensation

We standardize specialty-specific templates, apply charge capture rules, and reconcile daily to prevent revenue leakage.

Documentation & Charge Capture Variability

We manage the entire lifecycle, tracking expirations with automated alerts so new clinicians are enrolled and billable without delays.

  • Centralized Scheduling: Manage appointments for multi-location and multi-specialty practices from a single dashboard.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can E-nnovationrcm support us during payer audits (RADV)?
Yes. With CMS expanding Medicare Advantage RADV audits to all plans in 2025, audit readiness is critical. We tag MA claims, package audit-ready documentation bundles, and manage all communication with payers to protect your revenue from clawbacks.
How does accurate charge capture support provider compensation?
In group practices, compensation often depends on wRVU production. Missed charges lead to underpaid clinicians and disputes. We standardize charge capture and provide provider-level wRVU reports, ensuring compensation remains fair, transparent, and verified.
Can you integrate with our existing EHR?
Absolutely. We use middleware and API connectors to align clinical notes with claims. This ensures that prior authorization responses and evidence requirements are captured automatically, meeting strict payer standards.
How quickly can you onboard a new provider group?
Most groups are fully onboarded in 30�45 days. We handle the heavy lifting: setting up credentialing, mapping EHR workflows, and testing clearinghouse connections so billing runs smoothly from Day 1.
Whst is pricing structured for groups?
We offer flexible models based on claim volume and group size. Most groups prefer our performance-based model (percentage of collections), but hybrid and flat-fee FTE models are available.
